purpose: Guided DPDP readiness validation; not legal certification.

checks.title: India nexus and material scope
checks.verify: Determine Act s3 nexus and exclusions; do not infer solely from user IP or founder location.

checks.title: Standalone itemised notice
checks.verify: Review Act s5 and final Rule 3 against the actual collection flow.

checks.title: Consent capture and withdrawal
checks.verify: Check Act s6 requirements and that withdrawal is comparably easy; do not assume consent is the only permitted ground.

checks.title: Non-consent processing basis
checks.verify: Where relying on Act s7 specified legitimate uses, document the exact category and facts.

checks.title: Data Fiduciary general obligations
checks.verify: Review Act s8 obligations in context.

checks.title: Reasonable security safeguards
checks.verify: Review Act s8 and final Rule 6; validate controls technically rather than from policy text alone.

checks.title: Personal data breach response
checks.verify: Review Act s8 and final Rule 7; test the response workflow without creating a real incident.

checks.title: Erasure and retention
checks.verify: Review Act s8 and final Rule 8/Schedule where applicable; do not promise deletion that conflicts with required retention.

checks.title: Published business contact
checks.verify: Check final Rule 9 and applicable Act duties.

checks.title: Children and persons with lawful guardians
checks.verify: Review Act s9 and final Rules 10-12 including applicable exemptions; an age checkbox alone is not validation.

checks.title: Access, correction, erasure and nomination rights
checks.verify: Review Act ss11-14 and final Rule 14 against actual account and support flows.

checks.title: Grievance redressal
checks.verify: Review Act s13 and final Rule 14; record the actual mechanism and stated response period.

checks.title: Significant Data Fiduciary duties
checks.verify: Apply only if Central Government has designated the fiduciary under Act s10; verify current designation evidence.

checks.title: Cross-border transfer restrictions
checks.verify: Check Act s16 and final Rule 15 plus any current Central Government restrictions; do not assume blanket localisation.

checks.title: Consent Manager usage/registration
evidence: whether product acts as/uses a Consent Manager
checks.verify: Rule 4 starts one year after Gazette publication; ordinary apps are not automatically Consent Managers.

checks.title: Claimed exemption evidence
checks.verify: Never infer a startup or other exemption from size/name alone; retain official evidence and re-check scope.
